entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: An optional information element that may be included in certain messages when specific payload container types are used.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: An information element that specifies the type of payload container being used in the message.

entities.name: Payload container type is LPP message container
entities.description: Condition where the Payload container type IE is set to LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP) message container.

entities.name: Payload container type is LCS message container
entities.description: Condition where the Payload container type IE is set to Location services (LCS) message container.

relations.description: The Additional information IE may be included when the Payload container type is set to LPP message container.
The Additional information IE may be included when the Payload container type is set to LCS message container.
